title: acquisition-quickstart-sell-sheet-and-sim-demo-scripts
creator: Arianna Blake
description: Create a compact, battle-ready enablement kit aimed at acquisition-oriented sellers and Customer Success for the runtime-1.20 release. Focus on: concise sell-sheet, two short talk-tracks (PLG and Enterprise), three simulated demo scripts (SMB, Midmarket, Enterprise) that highlight low-latency / cost controls, fallback routing and the new qbatch optimizer, battlecard with key objection handlers and pricing teardown, and a one-page FAQ for pre-sales checks. Pack must be consumable in a 30–45 minute seller rehearsal and include one quick live-demo flow that can be run from a laptop with hosted API credentials.
success_criteria: Sales & CS can deliver a 15-minute pitch + 5-minute demo reliably after a single 45-minute run-through
Enablement materials accepted by Enablement lead (Liam Chen) and Director of Sales Ops
At least one pilot AE uses the kit in live outreach within 2 weeks of delivery
Kit links included in launch playbook and release notes, and referenced in weekly GTM sync
deliverables: Battlecard (2-page quick reference): TL;DR, top 5 objections, competitive positioning, pricing math
Two talk-tracks: PLG (developer-first, quick wins) and Enterprise (SLA/data controls/cost predictability)
Three demo scripts with branching prompts: SMB (30s lead gen flow), Midmarket (product search assistant demo), Enterprise (dedicated routing + fallback case)
Objection FAQ (top 12 questions with suggested answers)
Recording of a 45-minute seller rehearsal / training session
Short readiness checklist for AE/CS to sign-off before using kit in live outreach
timeline: Mar 11-12 - Draft talk-tracks and sell-sheet copy
Mar 16 - Finalize assets and record training session
Mar 17 - Publish to Drive + announce in GTM channels

notes: Keep the sell-sheet language under 250 words — used for cold outreach and one-pagers.
Demo scripts must include a fallback scenario where hosted capacity spikes and routing falls back to a cheaper model variant — show metrics (latency delta and cost delta).
Include a short script for handling pricing sensitivity: show token cost reduction levers (batching, quantization recommendation) and a sample SLA comparison table.
Avoid duplicating content in other enablement kits; link to PM-31234 and PM-27805 for related field assets.
Design should produce both A4 and US Letter PDFs; include speaker notes for each slide.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Runtime kernel tuning for qbatch not finalized — Mitigation: include a note explaining expected ranges and mark demo as 'representative' with pointers to runtime-1.20 release notes.
Risk: AE adoption slower than expected — Mitigation: pair with incentive: 2 pilot credits for first 5 AEs who run live demo; schedule drop-in office hours.
Risk: Conflicting messaging with Dedicated capacity docs — Mitigation: reconcile one-liner in battlecard and add 'When to recommend Dedicated' decision tree.

Number of live demos run using kit (target: 8 in first 2 weeks)
Click-throughs on sell-sheet link from outbound sequences
